preservedResponsibilities: Pinned SAL fallback for missing text-to-Unicode converters: byte-to-U+00xx output, early undefined-error flags, and destination capacity/consumption semantics.
For the default OString/OUString conversion flags, a missing converter copies each source byte to UTF-16 or truncates each UTF-16 unit to its low byte without throwing.
omittedResponsibilities: The Unicode-to-text dummy conversion and the full rtl converter lifecycle are outside the current Writer RTF import path.
Flag-specific error branches, destination-capacity/status cells, converter factories and all multibyte/contextual converter procedures remain unported.
